tips.text: Run Steel Path Isleweaver for the clamps; it never puts you in Drifter form, so your own Warframe and amp carry the run.
Use Isleweaver for the clamps and a full Duviri Experience for the materials; Isleweaver is resource-poor and has no Maw Fang.
Run Steel Path Duviri only with all three side portals; without them the extra clamps are not worth the time.
Skip The Lone Story for clamps; it pays the fewest per minute and has no side portals or Maw Fang.
Clear Maw feeding, Komi, Shawzin and the musical chests before combat; the free decrees rescue a bad loadout.
Run solo if a run ever pays no clamps; one run did after squadmates left mid-mission.
Players call the clamp grind a pure time tax: no RNG, but slow Undercroft stretches and a random Drifter loadout make it a chore.
Isleweaver is what made the clamps bearable; players avoid the Orowyrm farm now.
